summary: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ) filed an 8-K reporting that IQM Finland Oy publicly filed an F-4 registration statement in connection with their pending business combination. The transaction was originally announced Feb. 22, 2026, under a Business Combination Agreement. IQM will become a publicly traded company. No price, premium, or shareholder meeting date are disclosed in this filing. RAAQ is the blank-check SPAC issuer; the F-4 includes a preliminary proxy/prospectus for the extraordinary general meeting. Watch for SEC effectiveness, shareholder vote timing, and any redemption trends as the key risk-arb variables.
